title: The Fellowship of the LLMs: Multi-Model Workflows for Synthetic Preference Optimization Dataset Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a 'Bias Score' by computing the difference in agreement rates between the LLM evaluator and human evaluators for responses generated by Vicuna-13b versus GPT-3.5-Turbo, in order to quantify whether the LLM judge exhibits favoritism toward specific models or its own model family.
